_about: Public-domain Augustine Francis Hewit (1820-1897, Paulist, second Superior General of the Paulists) for the Word Hoard: Problems of the Age (1868), the Life of Francis A. Baker (fifth edition, 1868), Light in Darkness (1871), The King's Highway (1874) and The Teaching of St. John the Apostle (1895), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 33 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hewit-problems-of-age: Problems of the Age, with Studies in St. Augustine on Kindred Topics (New York: The Catholic Publication House, 1868)
hewit-life-francis-baker: Life of the Rev. Francis A. Baker, fifth edition (New York: The Catholic Publication House, 1868)
hewit-light-in-darkness: Light in Darkness: a Treatise on the Obscure Night of the Soul (New York: The Catholic Publication Society, 1871)
hewit-kings-highway: The King's Highway; or, the Catholic Church the Way of Salvation (New York: The Catholic Publication Society, 1874)
hewit-teaching-st-john: The Teaching of St. John the Apostle to the Churches of Asia and the World (New York: The Catholic Book Exchange, 1895)

_alternates.hewit-copies: The 1889 seventh edition of the Baker memoir; the 1893 reissues of Problems and The King's Highway

_excluded.hewit-others: Huntington's Gropings after Truth; his translation of a French life of Dumoulin Borie
